function.name: lookup_customer
function.description: Required next action once caller full name and usable callback number are known, before more routine intake questions. Automatically check membership; do not wait for a membership question. Use a supplied alternate number instead of caller ID. Reuse a successful result unless name/number changes. A match does not verify identity. For a unique name-and-number match, returns a fictional service_address: offer it for confirmation instead of asking the caller to recite it. Never assume it is the current job address.

phone_number.description: Best callback number: use caller ID if the caller agrees to use this number; otherwise read back a supplied number once.

function.name: assess_situation
function.description: Classify urgency from reported facts. Urgent HVAC can use reserved priority appointments; unresolved risks need clarification before saving. Speak emergency guidance immediately.

issue_type.description: Caller issue; no_heat/no_ac means a complete outage.

hazard.description: Reported safety condition. Unknown when unresolved. Speak emergency guidance immediately before calling tools.

vulnerable_occupant.description: True when caller reports an older adult, young child, or medically vulnerable person affected by the outage; false when denied. Infer from clear caller statements; do not repeat a question already answered. Omit when unknown.

indoor_conditions_unsafe.description: Use caller-reported indoor conditions: true when the home is uncomfortably hot/cold or unsafe from the outage; false when caller says indoor conditions are comfortable/not concerning. Infer from clear statements already given. Ask only if unclear; never ask city temperature or invent weather. Omit when unresolved.

function.name: check_service_area
function.description: Check assumed demo coverage using borough/county and state. Unrecognized locations need review; no guessed address or ZIP geocoding.

location.description: Caller-confirmed borough or county; do not infer from a phone area code.

state.description: State from caller context; Manhattan, Brooklyn or Queens in this NYC service context implies NY unless contradicted.

function.name: create_service_request
function.description: Save or update the same unbooked request for this call using ALL current intake details. After clarification resend corrected facts; missing_fields and next_question explain how to recover. If automatic_booking_allowed is true, immediately list appointments. Booked requests cannot change.

phone_number.description: Best callback number: use caller ID if the caller agrees to use this number; otherwise read back a supplied number once.

service_address.description: Full street address, apartment/unit if any, borough and ZIP as supplied. Do not guess.

location.description: Caller-confirmed borough or county; do not infer from a phone area code.

state.description: State from caller context; Manhattan, Brooklyn or Queens in this NYC service context implies NY unless contradicted.

property_type.description: My apartment, my house or my home means residential. Never ask home vs business again after such a statement. Unknown only if genuinely ambiguous.

issue_summary.description: Problem summary; include unverified membership claim if lookup unresolved.

system_type.description: Affected equipment, or unknown if caller does not know.

issue_started.description: When it began as caller reported; not provided if unavailable.

access_notes.description: Caller-provided access notes, or none reported / not provided as appropriate.

consent_to_save.description: True when the caller requests booking/recording this service or agrees to saving these details. Do not ask for duplicate permission.

issue_type.description: Caller issue; no_heat/no_ac means a complete outage.

hazard.description: Reported safety condition. Unknown when unresolved. Speak emergency guidance immediately before calling tools.

vulnerable_occupant.description: True when caller reports an older adult, young child, or medically vulnerable person affected by the outage; false when denied. Infer from clear caller statements; do not repeat a question already answered. Omit when unknown.

indoor_conditions_unsafe.description: Use caller-reported indoor conditions: true when the home is uncomfortably hot/cold or unsafe from the outage; false when caller says indoor conditions are comfortable/not concerning. Infer from clear statements already given. Ask only if unclear; never ask city temperature or invent weather. Omit when unresolved.

function.name: list_appointments
function.description: List available windows for this saved request: up to 16 routine windows across today and the next seven days, or reserved urgent capacity. Search all returned dates for caller preferences, but speak only up to two matching options at a time. Slots are not held; use returned local_window and slot_id.

request_id.description: Use the request_id returned by create_service_request in this same call.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: After caller agrees to an exact returned window, atomically book it. Confirm only booked. On slot_unavailable get consent for a fresh alternative. Retry identical args after timeout.

request_id.description: Use the request_id returned by create_service_request in this same call.

slot_id.description: Exact slot_id returned by availability for this request.

caller_confirmed.description: True only after caller explicitly agrees to this exact demo window.
